scope: Lake Taneycomo trout fishing operators and landings, incremental to the Table Rock inventory
recommended_first_source: The MDC trout-permit page and the Lake Taneycomo special-waterbody page, read with inventory.md. The permit catalog still has no guide roster.
highest_priority_permission_question: Will any office release a current list of businesses that guide sport fishing on Lake Taneycomo, limited to business name and water, and authorize commercial-directory reuse? The permit catalog checked on 2026-11-25 still publishes no holder list.

sources.field_scope: Angler permit catalog. Trout permit $12 resident, $24 nonresident, $6 youth. Required year-round on Lake Taneycomo upstream of U.S. Highway 65. No guide roster.
sources.bulk: HTML catalog. No download of guide holders.
sources.request_process: Buyers use the permit flow. Reproduction of site text requires written permission.

sources.field_scope: Trout permit prices and the Taneycomo upstream rule. Season blocks run through 2026 and into early 2027.
sources.request_process: Buy permit link. No directory process.

sources.field_scope: Creel and method rules for Lake Taneycomo. Brown trout 20-inch minimum. Daily limit 4 trout with only 1 brown. Closed zone 760 feet below Table Rock Dam. Slot and artificial-lure rules to Fall Creek.
sources.bulk: One HTML waterbody page. No guide file.

sources.field_scope: Written permission required before reproducing site text, images, or videos. Linking is allowed if origin stays clear and the material is not framed with outside advertising.
sources.request_process: Contact form for republication requests. No commercial-directory grant.

sources.field_scope: Dock home page. Boat and kayak rentals on Lake Taneycomo. Footer copyright 2026.
Guide referral prices for 4-hour and 6-hour trips. Guides are not named. No hull.
Rental classes and 2026-facing rates. Lengths and motor sizes are classes. Rate-sheet nicknames were not matched to a HIN.
Comment, cookie, and analytics privacy text. Google Analytics is named for traffic statistics. No directory grant. /terms/ returned HTTP 404.
sources.request_process: Account holders may request export or erasure of profile data. No commercial-directory process.

sources.field_scope: Taneycomo trip prices and a 20-year narrative. No hull. /privacy and /privacy-policy returned HTTP 404.
Taneycomo guided-trip prices, a 2024 Skeeter SX241 class, and a capacity claim of up to 12 guides. Copyright line on the page. /privacy-policy/ and /terms/ returned HTTP 404.
